name: Physician's Glance
description: Take one measuring look at a patient's soul and judge which harm is the gravest and which can wait.

name: Azure Poultice
description: Press a cool poultice of soul force on an ally's wound until the heat of the hurt is drawn.

name: Courtly Screen
description: Stand a quiet screen of soul force about a patient so no sudden strike can disturb the treatment.

name: Measured Restoration
description: Restore an ally's soul in even measured doses so each layer sets before the next is laid.

name: Tincture Cleansing
description: Steep a clear tincture of soul force through an ally and let it dissolve the taint it meets.

name: Fortifying Cordial
description: Give a weakened ally a cordial of soul force that braces the ally's will for the next ordeal.

name: Anima Rebuild
description: Rebuild an ally's ruined soul from its first outline with a long ordered cast of the healer's force.

name: Courtly Revival
description: Draw back the soul of an ally who stopped breathing moments ago and seat it again in the body.

name: Radiant Convalescence
description: Pour the healer's whole bright force into a nearly broken ally so the soul recovers in a single sustained rite.

name: Physician Palm
description: Lay both palms on a patient in the manner of the two healers and let a soothing warmth pass between them.

name: Paired Listening
description: Listen for the same note in a patient's soul through two healers' hands and find the flaw in it.

name: Gossamer Ward
description: Spread a silken ward of soul force across a patient that gives under a blow and returns to shape.

name: Twinned Breath
description: Breathe in step with an ally and lend the ally force with every shared breath.

name: Joined Restoration
description: Join the healer's force with a second healer's over one patient so the restoration moves twice as fast.

name: Twofold Purging
description: Drive a taint out of an ally with two pushes of force from opposite sides at once.

name: Counterbalance Mend
description: Set one hand against the other so every pull on a torn soul is met and balanced by an ally-side push.

name: Dyad Revival
description: Call back a newly stopped ally with two matched surges of force that start the soul and the heart together.

name: Matched Rebuild
description: Rebuild a broken soul with two mirrored casts of force so both halves return to the same shape.

name: Reconciled Soul
description: Reunite a soul that grief or a heavy blow has split in two and make the ally one person again.

name: Cistern Draught
description: Draw a measure of stored soul force from the healer's reserve and let an ally drink it in.

name: Fathom Reading
description: Sound the depth of a patient's soul reserve to learn how much force the ally has left.

name: Embankment Guard
description: Raise an embankment of force about a weakened ally so a rush of hostile force cannot flood the soul.

name: Brimming Cup
description: Hand an ally a brimming cup of soul force that restores the ally's drained will in one draught.

name: Dew Application
description: Let fine beads of soul force settle on a wound like dew until the hurt of the ally cools.

name: Spillover Mend
description: Let the basin overflow into an ally's wounds so every tear fills at the same time.

name: Sediment Purge
description: Stir the settled sediment of old poison in an ally's soul and flush it clear in one outflow.

name: Replenishing Cup
description: Refill an ally's spent soul reserve cup by cup until the ally can fight on.

name: Deepwater Restoration
description: Send restoring force down to the deepest layer of an ally's soul and raise the whole structure from below.

name: Tidal Revival
description: Send a great tide of soul force over a newly stopped ally and float the soul back into the body.

name: Endless Store
description: Hold open a basin of soul force that refills as fast as it is spent and restore a gravely hurt ally from it.

name: Pinion Salve
description: Stroke a feathered salve of soul force along an ally's wound until the pain lifts.

name: Falcon Scan
description: Sweep a sharp-eyed scan over a battlefield of wounded and pick out the souls closest to breaking.

name: Feathered Screen
description: Unfold a screen of layered feathers of force over a hurt ally that turns aside a flung blow.

name: Soaring Cheer
description: Send a rising call of soul force through an ally and lift the ally's sinking spirit.

name: Wingbeat Mending
description: Beat soft waves of soul force over an ally's wounds in time with the healer's slow breath.

name: Pinion Cleansing
description: Comb through an ally's soul with fingers of force and pull out every clinging strand of curse.

name: Hovering Vigor
description: Hold steady force above an ally like a hovering bird and feed it down in even measure.

name: Aerial Rescue
description: Snatch a newly fallen ally's soul out of the dark with a swooping grasp of force and return it.

name: Thermal Restoration
description: Raise a rising column of warm soul force beneath an ally and lift the soul back to health.

name: Skyward Restitution
description: Bear a gravely hurt ally's soul up on wide wings of force and lay it down whole.

name: Meander Salve
description: Lead a slow winding stream of soul force around the edges of a wound until it eases in the ally.

name: Shoal Reading
description: Feel for the shallows in a patient's soul where the force runs thin and the soul is weakest.

name: Reedbed Guard
description: Plant a thick bed of supple reeds of force about a patient to slow and break any hostile surge.

name: Slow Current
description: Run a patient slow current of soul force through an ally's wounds so the deepest ones close last.

name: Estuary Cleansing
description: Spread a taint across a wide shallow flow of force until it thins away to nothing in the ally.

name: Floodwater Vigor
description: Swell an ally's low reserve with a rising flood of soul force that fills every dry bed.

name: Thaw Revival
description: Warm the frozen soul of a newly stopped ally until it moves and returns to the body.

name: Confluent Rebuild
description: Bring many small streams of force together into one flow that rebuilds a shattered soul.

name: Broad Convalescence
description: Widen the flow of healing into a broad quiet delta that restores a gravely ill ally at last.

name: Windward Salve
description: Smooth a salve of soul force upwind of a wound so the clean air carries the hurt of the ally away.

name: Weathervane Sense
description: Turn the senses to where a patient's soul is being pushed and read the direction of the harm.

name: Crosswind Screen
description: Throw a screen of crossing air currents about a patient that scatters hostile soul force.

name: Tailwind Cheer
description: Push a steady tailwind of soul force behind a tired ally and carry the ally the last stretch.

name: Draft Poultice
description: Hold a cooling draft of soul force over a feverish soul until the ally's burning ceases.

name: Squall Mending
description: Close a gaping soul wound in one violent rush of force like a squall passing over an ally.

name: Calm Rinsing
description: Let a windless calm settle in an ally's soul until the stirred poison sinks and is cleared.

name: Lofty Resolve
description: Lift an ally's courage high on a clean wind so fear cannot reach the ally's mind.

name: Pledge Mooring
description: Anchor a drifting soul to the body with force bound to a spoken oath until the ally steadies.

name: Pledged Revival
description: Hold a newly stopped ally's soul on the healer's pledge and carry it back along a straight line of force.

name: Limitless Restoration
description: Send restoring force across the open air in every direction until the soul of an ally is whole.

name: Stormproof Wholeness
description: Carry an ally through the worst of a storm of harm and set the soul down unbroken on the far side.

name: Litany Salve
description: Sing a low line of verse over a wound while soul force closes it in the ally.

name: Voiceprint Reading
description: Hum a single note and listen to how a patient's soul answers to learn its state.

name: Chanted Ward
description: Chant a steady refrain that sets a ward of soul force about a patient for as long as it lasts.

name: Recited Mend
description: Recite the verse of mending and let each line close one tear in the ally's soul.

name: Verse Cleansing
description: Speak a cleansing verse over an ally and let each line lift a layer of taint from the soul.

name: Cantor's Strength
description: Sing a rising line that fills an ally's soul with the will to bear the coming pain.

name: Answering Revival
description: Call the name of a newly stopped ally in a rising chant until the soul answers and returns.

name: Choral Restoration
description: Raise a many-voiced chant of soul force that sets each shattered part of an ally's soul in place.

name: Unbroken Refrain
description: Sing the final verse without a pause until a gravely hurt ally's soul is whole and still.

name: Leeward Salve
description: Dab a calm salve of soul force on the sheltered side of a wound so the hurt of the ally settles.

name: Horizon Reading
description: Take a long steady look across a ward of wounded and mark which souls will fail first.

name: Steadfast Screen
description: Hold a screen of unmoving force before a sleeping patient through the whole of the night.

name: Sustaining Draught
description: Feed an ally a sustaining draught of soul force that keeps the ally's will up for hours.

name: Forbearing Mend
description: Mend an ally's soul with patient force that waits for each stitch to set before the next.

name: Distance Cleansing
description: Reach across a gap with a thread of soul force and draw a taint out of a distant ally.

name: Enduring Vigor
description: Grant an ally a slow-burning vigor of soul force that outlasts the hardest day.

name: Unyielding Restoration
description: Restore an ally's soul without yielding to its worst wounds however long the work may take.

name: Homeward Revival
description: Draw a newly stopped ally's soul homeward along the thread that still binds it to the body.

name: Distant Wholeness
description: Make a gravely hurt ally whole by casting restoring force across a great gap with a true aim.

name: Airy Poultice
description: Lay a light poultice of moving air and force on a wound so the heat leaves an ally.

name: Respiration Reading
description: Read the rhythm of a patient's breath to learn how deeply the soul has been shaken.

name: Windbreak Screen
description: Set a windbreak of force to the side of a patient where the harmful push comes from.

name: Lifting Breeze
description: Raise a gentle breeze under an ally's flagging spirit and hold it up until it recovers.

name: Cloud Compress
description: Press a soft cool cloud of force to a swollen soul wound until the ally's pain recedes.

name: Skyward Mending
description: Draw the hurt out of a soul toward the open sky while force fills the place it leaves.

name: Windscouring
description: Scour a soul clean with a steady dry wind of force that takes the taint and leaves the soul whole.

name: Windfed Vigor
description: Feed an ally the strength of a rising wind until the ally's tired limbs and mind revive.

name: Slipstream Restoration
description: Draw an ally's soul into a smooth fast stream of force that carries every wound to its healing.

name: Revival Gust
description: Drive one hard gust of soul force into the chest of a newly stopped ally to restart the soul.

name: Zenith Convalescence
description: Lift a gravely harmed ally into clean high air and set the whole soul to recover at its peak.

name: Unbowed Salve
description: Rub a firm salve of soul force into a deep wound and keep at it however stubborn the hurt.

name: Resolve Reading
description: Measure how much hope a patient's soul still holds and how much force it will take to rouse it.

name: Rooted Screen
description: Root a screen of force in the ground beside a patient so no blow can shift the healer or the ward.

name: Resolute Cheer
description: Call out to a flagging ally with a strong word and steady the ally's soul with force.

name: Vigil Poultice
description: Keep a poultice of soul force on a wound through the whole vigil and renew it as it cools.

name: Unflinching Mend
description: Mend a gruesome soul wound without flinching and without pausing until the ally is closed.

name: Vow Purging
description: Purge a binding curse from an ally by the force of the healer's sworn word and steady force.

name: Staunch Vigor
description: Pour unshaken strength into an ally who has been given up on until the ally can rise.

name: Sworn Stitch
description: Sew a torn soul with a thread that the healer has sworn will not part under any strain.

name: Stalwart Restoration
description: Restore a soul that others have called beyond mending by holding to the work through the worst hour.

name: Oathkeeper Revival
description: Keep the oath never to abandon a patient and draw a newly stopped ally's soul back to the body.

name: Hale Rebuilding
description: Rebuild a ruined soul stout and hale from a single sustained cast of the healer's whole will.

name: Unbowed Wholeness
description: Lift an ally whom all had given up for lost back to full wholeness of soul by a final unbowed rite.
